info.title: aiairouter API
info.description:
# Quickstart

Image requests use an `API-KEY` header. Chat requests also accept `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.

1. Sign in at the [API Console](https://aiairouter.com/dashboard). Google sign-in is supported.
2. A default `API-KEY` is created with the account. New accounts receive 10 quota as a trial balance.
3. Send the key on every request: `API-KEY: YOUR_API_KEY`. For chat, `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` is equivalent.

The full guide, including the first image request, is in the [Quickstart](https://docs.aiairouter.com/quickstart).

Image generation API. POST /v1/images/generations is the recommended entry for Midjourney, GPT Image, Grok, and Gemini models. The existing Midjourney and GPT routes remain available.

Chat API. POST /v1/chat/completions is an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Set the OpenAI SDK base URL to `https://api.aiairouter.com/v1`.

post.description:
OpenAI-compatible chat completion. A successful call returns the completion JSON, or an SSE stream when `stream` is true.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`, a raw `Authorization` value, or an `API-KEY` header. A `Bearer` prefix is stripped. The key IP allowlist still applies.

`model` is required. Any other model returns HTTP 400 with `error` set to `This model is temporarily not supported.`

Prices are USD per 1 million tokens. The charged price is the list price multiplied by the model discount. Cached input uses the cache price. 1 USD = 130 quota. When prompt tokens exceed the long-context threshold, input and cache are multiplied by 2 and output by 1.5 before the discount.
gpt-6.1-sol: input 2, cache 0.10, output 10, discount 0.18, long context above 272000.
gpt-6.1-terra: input 1, cache 0.05, output 5, discount 0.15, long context above 272000.
gpt-6-sol: input 2, cache 0.20, output 10, discount 0.18, long context above 272000.
gpt-6-astra: input 10, cache 1, output 50, discount 0.22, long context above 272000.
gpt-6-luna: input 0.10, cache 0.01, output 0.50, discount 0.45, long context above 272000.
gpt-5.6-sol: input 5, cache 0.50, output 30, discount 0.18, long context above 272000.
grok-4.7: input 2, cache 0.5, output 6, discount 0.13, long context above 200000.
grok-4.6: input 2, cache 0.5, output 6, discount 0.13, long context above 200000.
claude-opus-5-5: input 4, cache 0.2, output 20, discount 0.25.
claude-sonnet-5-5: input 2, cache 0.1, output 10, discount 0.25.
claude-opus-5: input 5, cache 0.5, output 25, discount 0.25.
claude-sonnet-5: input 2, cache 0.2, output 10, discount 0.25.
claude-opus-4-8: input 5, cache 0.5, output 25, discount 0.25.
claude-opus-4-7: input 5, cache 0.5, output 25, discount 0.25.

Quota must be greater than 5 before the call. Otherwise the response is HTTP 402 and the body is `{ "status": 1001, "code": 1001, "message": "Quota must be greater than 5." }`. A missing or invalid key is HTTP 401. An IP that is not allowed is HTTP 403. After a billed call, quota is deducted from token usage and the balance may go negative. The request is logged immediately. The token bill is filled in when it becomes available. A call whose bill never arrives stays in the log with zero quota and is not deducted.

post.description: Existing Midjourney imagine endpoint. New integrations can use POST /v1/images/generations with model midjourney. Prompt flags such as --ar, --niji, --v, and --hd stay inside prompt.
Existing Midjourney task result endpoint. Pass the taskIds returned by submit-jobs. New integrations can poll GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}.
Existing GPT image task result endpoint. Pass the taskIds returned by POST /gpt/v1/generations. New integrations can poll GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}.
Existing GPT image endpoint. Supported models are gpt-image-2, gpt-image-2.5, and gpt-image-2.6. New integrations can use POST /v1/images/generations with the same fields.

get.description: List models accepted by POST /v1/images/generations, including parameters.

post.description:
Recommended create endpoint for Midjourney, GPT Image, Grok, and Gemini image models.

Send a flat JSON body. Unknown fields return HTTP 400. There is no nested options object.

Grok and Gemini do not accept size. A successful call returns immediately with status queued. Poll GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}, or set hookUrl to receive the same task body.

value.prompt: a boy play with a girl --niji 7 --ar 3:4
draw a boy play with a girl
a dog play with a girl
a dog play with a girl

get.description:
Status endpoint for tasks created by POST /v1/images/generations.

GPT Image, Grok, and Gemini return ImageTask: status is queued, processing, succeeded, or failed. The body includes the submitted prompt and parameters on every status. A succeeded task includes data[{ url }] and usage.cost.

Midjourney returns MidjourneyTask, the same fields as POST /midjourney/v1/job-status, plus the submitted prompt, mode, and timeout. status is a number: 0 in progress, 1 succeeded, 2 failed. A succeeded task includes the grid, the four images, and usage.cost.

value.prompt: a dog play with a girl
a dog play with a girl
a dog play with a girl

get.description:
Get the remaining quota for the current API key.

Rate limit: 10 requests per 60 seconds for each API key. When the limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header. Poll at most once every 6 seconds.

message.example: API KEY error, please check your api key

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request

message.example: Too many requests. Please try again later.

prompt.example: a boy play with a girl --niji 7

timeout.description:
Task timeout
- Unit: seconds
- Range: 300 - 1200
- Default: 600

prompt.description:
Text prompt for image generation.

Since this is a reverse-engineered model, it's recommended to include keywords in your prompt such as:
- "draw a xxx"
- "generate a xxx"

Language is not restricted; OpenAI itself supports multilingual models with excellent Chinese support.
prompt.example: draw a boy play with a girl

model.description: Supported models: gpt-image-2, gpt-image-2.5, gpt-image-2.6. Required by the endpoint.

size.description:
Support model: gpt-image-2

Available options: 1K, 4K
Default: 1K

4K is better at keeping other areas unchanged in image editing scenarios

output_size.description:
Support model: gpt-image-2. Custom output width and height in WIDTHxHEIGHT format, e.g. "1920x1080". Only takes effect when size is "4K"; ignored for 1K.

A parsed value overrides aspect_ratio. Unparseable values are ignored and the request keeps aspect_ratio sizing.

The server auto-corrects a parsed value:
- both sides snapped to multiples of 16
- longest edge ≤ 3840
- aspect ratio clamped to 1:3–3:1
- total pixels clamped to 655360–8294400

Examples:
- "100x100" → 816x816
- "1920x1080" → 1920x1088
- "5000x100" → 3840x1280
- "10000x10000" → 2880x2880

status.description:
Status code:
- 0: success
- 1001: quota not enough
- 1002: concurrency limit, max 30

quota.description: Remaining quota of the current account

MidjourneyGeneration.description: Midjourney on POST /v1/images/generations. Put aspect ratio and reference images in prompt, for example --ar 3:4.

prompt.description: Prompt, including Midjourney flags such as --niji, --v, --ar, and --hd.
prompt.example: a boy play with a girl --niji 7 --ar 3:4

GptGeneration.description: GPT Image on POST /v1/images/generations. Same fields as POST /gpt/v1/generations.

prompt.example: draw a boy play with a girl

output_size.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT, for example 1920x1080. Applied only when size is 4K. Ignored for 1K.

GrokGeneration.description: Grok Imagine Image Quality. Send model grok-imagine-image-quality. Do not send size. aspect_ratio accepts 1:1, 3:2, 2:3, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, and 21:9. Default is 1:1. At most 4 reference images.

prompt.example: a dog play with a girl

GeminiGeneration.description: Gemini image models. Do not send size. If aspect_ratio is omitted and a reference image is sent, output follows that image.

prompt.example: a dog play with a girl

HookUrl.description: Optional http(s) callback URL. The body matches GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}, including the submitted prompt and parameters, plus data, usage, or error.

ImageTask.description: GPT Image, Grok, and Gemini task. Parameters declared for that model are returned with the same names. hookUrl is not returned.

model.description: Public model id stored for the task.

prompt.example: a dog play with a girl

aspect_ratio.description: Submitted aspect ratio. Grok uses 1:1 when the request omitted it. Gemini omits this field when the request omitted it.

size.description: GPT Image only. The submitted size. Default: 1K.

output_size.description: GPT Image only. Present when a 4K output_size was applied.

referImages.description: Reference image URLs submitted with the task.

usage.description: Present when status is succeeded. cost is the quota charged for this task.

MidjourneyTask.description: Midjourney result from GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}. Same item shape as POST /midjourney/v1/job-status.

status.description: 0 in progress, 1 succeeded, 2 failed. Other stored failure codes are returned as-is.

timeout.description: Submitted timeout in seconds, when the request set one.

model.description: Chat model id. Copy this value into the request.

stream.description: When true, the response is an SSE stream.

ChatCompletionResponse.description: Successful bodies match the OpenAI chat completion object. This schema only lists the fields clients use to detect an error body.

status.description: Present on auth or quota failure. 401 invalid key, 403 IP denied, 1001 quota too low.

error.example: This model is temporarily not supported.

model.description: Present when the model is not supported.
